deficits.evidence: Dropped kerbs not visible at the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Install raised platforms with tactile paving at the crossing to ensure safe pedestrian access and improve visibility for drivers.

deficits.evidence: Crossing is marked but lacks visibility and safety features

deficits.evidence: Wide road with 4 or more lanes and no refuge island
deficits.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing a wide road.
